title: Basic Process Documentation
goal: Learn how to describe a business problem before code is written. Start with SDLC, flow charts, DFD, database basics, ERD, use cases, and API basics.

title: Intermediate Modeling
goal: Convert business understanding into developer-friendly models. Study UML, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, component diagrams, REST API design, relationships, and clean architecture.

title: Advanced Architecture
goal: Move from feature documentation to architecture decisions. Learn HLD, LLD, system design, modular monolith, microservices, event-driven design, scalability, and performance.

title: Enterprise ERP Architecture
goal: Understand ERP as a connected enterprise platform. Study module ownership, ERP data flow, deployment architecture, security architecture, and DevOps CI/CD.

title: Capstone Documentation Portfolio
goal: Create one complete documentary pack for a real ERP module such as HR, Payroll, Inventory, Sales, Procurement, or Finance.
